classification.difficultyReason: Systematically forms sums and differences of three supplied special angles and excludes known angles and values outside the acute interval.

content.prompt: Using one sum or difference of two angles chosen from $30^\circ$, $45^\circ$ and $60^\circ$, list all other angles in $0^\circ<\theta<90^\circ$ whose exact trigonometric values can be found using the sum and difference expansions.

answer.worked: $45^\circ-30^\circ=15^\circ$ and $60^\circ-45^\circ=15^\circ$. Also, $30^\circ+45^\circ=75^\circ$. All other sums and differences give a known angle or an angle outside $0^\circ<\theta<90^\circ$. Hence the other acute angles are $15^\circ$ and $75^\circ$.
